name: NASA POWER
tagline: NASA agroclimatology solar, temperature, and precipitation by lat/lon
description: NASA Prediction Of Worldwide Energy Resources (POWER) provides satellite- and model-based agroclimatology parameters (solar irradiance, temperature, precipitation, humidity, wind) at point locations for crop modeling, energy, and climate applications via a public REST API.

auth.details: No API key required; public REST endpoints accept query parameters without authentication.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public access is subject to endpoint constraints: daily point requests allow up to 20 parameters, regional requests allow one parameter, and repeated requests for the same relative location may be blocked.

rate_limits: No per-minute quota is published. NASA advises no more than five concurrent requests; excessive synchronous requests may be blocked, and HTTP 429 is documented.
use_cases: get daily solar radiation for a farm lat/lon
fetch temperature and precipitation time series for crop models
download agroclimatology CSV for a field location
query multi-year climate normals for planting decisions
